description: Soil pH is acidic. Acidic soils lead to reduced availability of phosphorus, calcium, and magnesium, and potential aluminum toxicity.
fertilizer_recommendation: Apply agricultural lime (calcium carbonate) or dolomite @ 2-4 tonnes/ha to raise pH. Use rock phosphate for phosphorus.
irrigation_tip: Maintain adequate soil moisture to prevent rapid pH fluctuations and leaching.

description: Soil pH is in the optimal range for maximum nutrient availability, robust root development, and high microbial activity.
fertilizer_recommendation: Apply balanced NPK fertilizers (e.g. 19:19:19 or 20:20:20) along with 5-10 tonnes/ha of well-rotted Farm Yard Manure (FYM).
irrigation_tip: Follow recommended crop watering schedules; drip irrigation recommended for water conservation.
risk_factors: Low risk; maintain organic carbon levels

description: Soil pH is high (alkaline). Causes deficiency of micronutrients like Zinc, Iron, Manganese, and reduced Phosphorus uptake.
fertilizer_recommendation: Apply Gypsum @ 1-2 tonnes/ha or Elemental Sulfur @ 200-500 kg/ha. Use Zinc Sulfate (ZnSO4) @ 25 kg/ha and Ferrous Sulfate (FeSO4).
irrigation_tip: Provide leaching irrigations to drain excess salts below the root zone.

description: Low nitrogen levels reduce leaf chlorosis, stunted growth, and low tillering or branching in crops.
fertilizer_recommendation: Apply split doses of Urea (46% N) @ 50-100 kg/ha or Neem-coated Urea. Integrate biofertilizers like Azotobacter or Rhizobium.
irrigation_tip: Irrigate immediately after top-dressing Urea to facilitate root uptake.

description: Phosphorus deficiency leads to reddish-purple leaf pigmentation, poor root establishment, and delayed flowering.
fertilizer_recommendation: Apply Single Super Phosphate (SSP) @ 150-250 kg/ha or Di-Ammonium Phosphate (DAP) @ 100 kg/ha during basal soil preparation.
irrigation_tip: Keep soil moist at root depth; dry soil restricts phosphorus diffusion to roots.

description: Potassium deficiency affects plant strength, disease resistance, and grain fill, causing marginal leaf scorching.
fertilizer_recommendation: Apply Muriate of Potash (MOP / 60% K2O) @ 50-80 kg/ha or Sulfate of Potash (SOP) for sensitive crops.
irrigation_tip: Avoid waterlogging; potassium uptake requires adequate soil aeration.

description: Low organic carbon indicates depleted soil organic matter, reduced water retention, and poor microbial biodiversity.
fertilizer_recommendation: Incorporate Farm Yard Manure (FYM) @ 10 tonnes/ha, compost, or green manure crops like Sunnhemp / Dhaincha.
irrigation_tip: Mulch soil surface with crop residues to conserve soil moisture.

description: Spindle-shaped lesions or rapid foliage browning observed. Common in high humidity and excess nitrogen conditions.
fertilizer_recommendation: Avoid excess application of nitrogenous fertilizers. Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2 g/L.
irrigation_tip: Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; switch to drip or flood to keep leaf foliage dry.
risk_factors: Rapid crop loss within 7-10 days under moist weather
